required_runtime.population_mode: independent scene clones sharing ordinary geometry/materials; any GPU-instanced variant must be measured and reported separately

required_actual_evidence: Exact loaded GLB hash and source/renderer versions.
Renderer/device and real GPU versus software fallback identification; preserve approved headed/in-app-browser constraints.
Actual visible clone counts and saved scene/camera/light/shadow/resolution/DPR configuration.
Screenshots and shader/console errors, visible scale/contact/leaf-normal/backface/material checks.
Measured renderer.info calls/triangles, warmup and sampled frame timing distribution, with test conditions.
Do not substitute triangle arithmetic or parser timings for GPU frame times.
integration_after_acceptance: Integration task should use latest main, exact accepted GLB/blend hashes and24 alpha previews rendered from that same accepted GLB. Current evidence is diagnostic CPU imagery; no24alpha release-preview success claimed.
